info.title: getpack-web contract requests
info.description: Endpoints getpack-web needs and getpack-api has not published: the operations its triage (src/lib/api/requests/triage.ts, from getpack-api docs/contract-requests-triage.md) marks `implement here`, plus any written since the triage. A request, not a contract: the backend owns the contract (api-conventions §1). The why for each operation is its row in docs/contract-requests.md (`x-contract-request`). Generated by `pnpm gen:api` from src/lib/api/requests — do not edit.
